messages:
maria: Quick check — RFC clinic tomorrow 11am PT. Need final slot lineup. Can authors who are presenting confirm or hand off by EOD? Pre-read link: https://redwood.internal/rfcs/pre-reads (short)
sam: I can present my tiny-routing RFC, unless someone else wants it. Will upload a 2-slide summary by 6pm.
alex: Can we move sam a bit earlier? I'd like the reviewers to be in the room for his discussion.
jordan: I'm available at 11, but earlier is tight. If sam moves to 10:40 I can make that.
maria: Tentative order I'm thinking: 10:30 — onboarding templates (jamie), 10:40 — tiny-routing (sam), 11:00 — cache-v2 (lee). If you can't make your slot, drop a 'handoff @someone' or propose a swap.
jamie: I can do 10:30. Pre-read posted at `docs/rfcs/onboarding-templates.md` — top comment has TL;DR.
lee: I'm out 10:30–10:50. Can swap with sam? I can review tiny-routing if that helps.
sam: I prefer 10:40 but if lee can review my PR I'll move to 11:10. Otherwise keep 10:40.
maria: If we shift sam -> 11:10 then cache-v2 moves into 10:40. Please react :+1: or :thumbsdown: to this message by 4pm so I can lock the agenda.
alex: +1
jordan: +1
lee: -1 (I need the 10:40 window). I can take jamie's slot if jamie ok with swap.
jamie: OK swapping with lee — jamie -> 10:40, lee -> 10:30. I'll update the pre-read and drop a short summary.
maria: Perfect. Action items: jamie update pre-read (comment the diff), sam upload slides or say 'pass' by 6pm, reviewers @alex @jordan @lee — skim pre-reads and add any must-discuss bullets. I'll update calendar with final agenda.
calendar-bot: Meeting updated: "RFC Clinic — slots" tomorrow 11:00 AM PT. Agenda attached.
maria: Thanks everyone. If any last-minute handoffs, ping me DM so I can do a final shuffle."
